name: keelcrew
description: Keelcrew for Claude Code: a Mate (first mate) that staffs your tickets and tasks with switchable agents, learns how you work, and keeps merges and posts waiting for your OK.

plugins.name: keelcrew
plugins.description: A crew of Claude Code sessions inside the Claude app: a Mate (first mate) that learns your style, switchable agents (engineer, QA, reviewer, analyst, writer and more), a private Keelcrew board, team packs, fixed rules so merges and posts wait for your OK, and a panel that wakes the Mate when you act on the board.
